title: Rational Synthesizers or Heuristic Followers? Analyzing LLMs in RAG-based Question-Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Illusory Truth Effect by comparing the rate at which models change their answers when presented with distinct, independent counter-evidence versus redundant, paraphrased variations of a single counter-evidence document.

Isolating the impact of document presentation order by permuting the sequence of balanced, conflicting evidence (e.g., Supportive-First vs. Opposing-First) in the model's context window to see if early tokens act as disproportionate anchors.
Measuring belief plasticity and answer flip thresholds by analyzing the amount of opposing retrieved evidence required to override a model's intrinsic parametric prior.
